doc.title: Wendy Oxenhorn interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 22, 2026

title: Technical adjustment of the camera
summary: Monk asks her to adjust her screen for the closed captions, then returns to the harmonica.

story.theme_name: Tape changes, reel headers and session breaks
story.community_name: Tape changes, reel headers and session breaks

blocks.x: I’m going to pause for one second. Do you have a movable screen?
Oh, I do. Sorry. That’s my foot kicking the table?
No, no, no it’s not that. Can you bend it forward a little bit so that you’re higher in the picture?

That’s better, even a little more if you can. The reason for that is we do closed captions and – yeah, yeah. Okay. So I’ll just pick up from there. So did you have the little suitcase with all the different keys for the harmonica?
